The '''Imperial Elite Guard''' was an elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit assigned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect important [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|government officials]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
===Galactic Civil War===
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was not uncommon for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the Guard to be led in combat by certain [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commanders]]. These officers were often crucial to a victory. As such, they were usually kept in the rear of an invasion, or safely in an Imperial base.

However, when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces began to attack lightly defended imperial bases, often bypassing the main army, it became clear that the empire would need to defend their valuable commanders. As commanders were not trained in combat, the solution was to guard them with stormtroopers that would stay with them at all times.

The forces were rarely seen guarding other Imperial officers, and it is possible they were only used for this purpose. The were in many ways the equivalent to the [[Alliance Elite Guard]].

===Legacy===
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were killed over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] during [[Battle of Endor/Legends|the battle there]]. In the small successor state formed after the Empire dwindled from [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] formed an elite [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] unit known as the [[Imperial Elite Guard]]. They performed a similar function during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], protecting officers such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. However, the Elite Guard failed to stop [[Tahiri Veila]] from killing the admiral.

==Training==
These soldiers were given the same training as standard Imperial stormtroopers. However, it is likely that they were given a higher emphasis on defense, in addition to operating in tightly knit squads. They were given the same equipment as Stormtroopers, [[Cold assault stormtrooper|Snowtroopers]], and [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtroopers]], depending on the environment.
